title: 내일도 질 거야
suno_analysis_sp: K-Indie Pop. Clean electric guitar plays a syncopated, palm-muted rhythmic pattern with light chorus and reverb. A sub-heavy synth bass follows the kick drum pattern. Drums consist of a tight, dry kick on beats 1 and 3, with a crisp snare on 2 and 4, and closed hi-hats playing straight eighth notes. A breathy, soft female vocal sits forward in the mix with subtle doubling and short plate reverb. Occasional bright, bell-like synth plucks accent the transitions. Key of E Major. Tempo is 92 BPM. 4/4 time signature.
suno_analysis_lyrics:
[Intro]
[syncopated clean electric guitar, soft kick drum]

[Verse 1]
[breathy female vocals]
옥상에 올라와 노을이 터지지
주머니에서 폰 [shutter sound effect]
찰칵 한 장 찍어 예쁘다 이거야
올릴까 말까 해
전체 공개 무서워 친한 친구만 해
딱 너만 보라고 노을 한 장 올려
너만 볼 수 있게 날 대신 사진이
너를 보는 중
